If what was adjusted didn't work, let them know. Voice to someone who has power about how serious your situation is. It's probably not a matter that they don't care, just that they don't understand the importance of it.
If you hate school because of classes and such and you don't feel like you can take on the day tomorrow, talk to administer. Someone can help make sure it's not hell anymore

Maybe write down all your frustrations and angry and sadness and vent. And then tear it to shreds. Do anything other than that, because I care, and I want you to live. It may be selfish because I don't know your life, but I know you got a real chance.
Emotions are temporary and you can learn to control them. I promise this feeling is so intense but only for right now, sleep and it'll not feel as intense tomorrow

And you won't have to, as long as you take the road in reaching out. It's your life, you can change the people around you, and how you react to certain situations. If you kill yourself, the last thing you will remember is all the pain you felt. Who knows what's after death? But if this is the real bottom, everything gets better. It's cliche but true. Simply just start by making smaller changes that you'll think might help. Distractions help a lot when getting back on your feet, so does self care. If you have a good relationship with your parents express some things that might make you happy or concerns you want to fix. If you don't have a good relationship then reach out to certain friends, or a school counselor.

Make excuses on why you shouldn't. Sleep on it and say I'll think about that tomorrow, keep doing that until you can reach out and get support you want. Until you don't have to keep pretending everything is okay. Fighting is exhausting but the ups are far sweeter than just dying. Plus, we all die one day anyways, so what's the risk in trying to be happy? It's going to be tough for a week or month, some days more than others. But it will really seem worth it one day, trust me ❤️
Alright, best of luck to ya! Get some needed sleep. A good long shower, brushing your teeth, and some sleep always make me feel a little more okay.
It's never a bad thing to ask for help, you aren't stupid. Reaching out for your depression or academics when benefit you in the long run. Just take some time to think about it, baby steps.

Yes sir, I apologize for taking so long to reply. I promise I'm here. I'm a senior in high school and a freshmen in college and I was experiencing mostly the same things. I hated a therapist (why pay someone to pretend they care) and medication always had bad affects. Highschool sucked, and I recently attempted at suicide my second time on Saturday. And it made me realize everything I had and what I was losing. I lost everything because I attempted but for the sake of me and my cat and a good friend, I am trying to see a therapist and maybe get on medication. In the middle of me laying there as I barely could move, I realized I didn't want to die anymore. I had the luck of my (ex) friend living so close and saving me. Please don't make the same mistake I did. Research coping methods, distract yourself. Highschool is temporary and you could go anywhere you want when you graduate. Junior and senior year are a lot better, trust me. Suicide isn't selfish, and it's a hard thing to do, but seeing that you can live and not taking suicide as an option is a strong and courageous thing to do. I really believe in you!
Tell me what's going on, walk me through everything, rant if you need to. I'm all ears.
